document_title: Development of Distribution Infrastructure & System Strengthening works at Nagpur Zone of MSEDCL, Maharashtra under Power Distribution Enhancement Program funded by Asian Development Bank (ADB)

sub_headings.heading: tender_title
sub_headings.content: Development of Distribution Infrastructure & System Strengthening works at Nagpur Zone of MSEDCL, Maharashtra under Power Distribution Enhancement Program funded by Asian Development Bank (ADB)

sub_headings.heading: tender_no
sub_headings.content: CE-SPD/ADB/2026-27/T-13 VERSION-2

sub_headings.heading: issuing_authority
sub_headings.content: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL)

sub_headings.heading: tender_type
sub_headings.content: Works Tender

sub_headings.heading: bid_type
sub_headings.content: Two Bid (Single Stage Two-Envelope System)

sub_headings.heading: funding_agency
sub_headings.content: Asian Development Bank (ADB)

sub_headings.heading: tender_fee
sub_headings.content: 25000 + 18% GST (Non-refundable)

sub_headings.heading: budget_type
sub_headings.content: Capex

sub_headings.heading: scheme
sub_headings.content: Power Distribution Enhancement Program

sub_headings.heading: name
sub_headings.content: Chief Engineer (Special Projects)

sub_headings.heading: designation
sub_headings.content: Chief Engineer

sub_headings.heading: email
sub_headings.content: cespd.msedcl@gmail.com

sub_headings.heading: pre_bid_meeting
sub_headings.content: 26 May 2026 at 15:00 Hours

sub_headings.heading: bid_submission_deadline
sub_headings.content: 09 June 2026 up to 15:00 Hours

sub_headings.heading: technical_opening_date
sub_headings.content: 09 June 2026 at 16:00 Hours

sub_headings.heading: financial_opening_date
sub_headings.content: Will be declared later

sub_headings.heading: type
sub_headings.content: Full Turnkey Contract (Design, Supply and Installation)

sub_headings.heading: location
sub_headings.content: Nagpur Zone of MAHARASHTRA STATE

sub_headings.heading: components
sub_headings.content: 11 kV, 22 kV, 33 kV system strengthening, creation of new substations, capacity augmentation, replacement of conductors, installation of RMUs and capacitor banks.

sub_headings.heading: turnover
sub_headings.content: Positive for each of the last 3 financial years

sub_headings.heading: projects
sub_headings.content: Similar distribution infrastructure works completed successfully in the past 5 years.

sub_headings.heading: maat
sub_headings.content: ≥ 30% of tender cost (~Rs. 157.64 Cr) – best 3 of last 5 FY

sub_headings.heading: liquid_assets
sub_headings.content: ≥ 10% of tender cost (~Rs. 52.55 Cr) – banker's certificate required

sub_headings.heading: pending_litigation
sub_headings.content: ≤ 50% of bidder's net worth

sections.heading: jv_requirements
sections.content: JV (up to 3 partners): All partners individually meet Net Worth; collectively meet MAAT & LA. Lead partner ≥ 40%; others ≥ 25% each of MAAT/LA criteria.

sub_headings.heading: emd
sub_headings.content: 2% of tender value OR Rs. 5 Cr (whichever LOWER) | Form: Unconditional eBG from Scheduled Bank

sub_headings.heading: beneficiary_name
sub_headings.content: MSEDCL

sub_headings.heading: bank_name
sub_headings.content: Bank of Maharashtra, Fort

sub_headings.heading: bid_validity
sub_headings.content: 180 days from date of opening of Technical Part

sub_headings.heading: performance_security
sub_headings.content: 3% of Contract Price | Valid till 30 days beyond Warranty Period

sub_headings.heading: cpg_supply
sub_headings.content: 10% of Contract Price Part I (eBG)

sub_headings.heading: cpg_erection
sub_headings.content: 3% of Contract Price Part II (eBG)

sub_headings.heading: advance_payment
sub_headings.content: Supply (Part I): 15% (2 × 7.5%) with BG of 110% per installment. Erection (Part II): 10% (2 × 5%) with Site office mobilization required. BG of 110% per installment.

sub_headings.heading: progressive_payments
sub_headings.content: Supply: 1st 60% on receipt & acceptance, 2nd 30% on erection, testing & commissioning, Final 10% on Completion Certificate. Erection: 1st 90% on erection, testing & commissioning, Final 10% on Completion Certificate + GIS asset tagging + asset takeover.

sub_headings.heading: payment_timeline
sub_headings.content: Released within 60 days of invoice.

sub_headings.heading: interest_on_delay
sub_headings.content: Delayed payment attracts interest at SBI 1-yr MCLR.

sub_headings.heading: applicability
sub_headings.content: Price Adjustment is applicable on Ex-works price component (less advance) only for specified materials. All other components are FIRM for entire contract duration.

sub_headings.heading: materials
sub_headings.content: ACSR Conductor, Power Transformer (Station), Distribution Transformer (Al wound & Cu wound), HT/LT Power & Control Cables, Switchgear, Circuit Breakers & Isolators, Steel Structures, Steel Tubular Poles, Aerial Bunched Cables (ABC).

sub_headings.heading: rules
sub_headings.content: PV applicable from contract signing date. If contractor is delayed (own reasons): PV not applicable for delay period. All prices/indices as published by IEEMA.

sub_headings.heading: completion_time
sub_headings.content: 24 months from Effective Date of Contract

sub_headings.heading: defect_liability_period
sub_headings.content: 12 months from Completion Certificate (extendable up to 24 months max.)

sub_headings.heading: liquidated_damages
sub_headings.content: 0.15% per week of unexecuted works value | Cap: 5% of unexecuted works value

sub_headings.heading: quality_penalties
sub_headings.content: Major defects: 0.5% of contract cost | Minor defects: 0% if rectified within 30 days

sub_headings.heading: tpqma_inspection
sub_headings.content: Pre-dispatch (3 weeks notice domestic, 6 weeks imports) + field inspections by employer-engaged agency

sub_headings.heading: gis_asset_tagging
sub_headings.content: Mandatory – assets to be tagged & uploaded to employer's GIS portal before final payment

sub_headings.heading: works_license
sub_headings.content: Valid electrical works license required; state-specific license within 2 months of award

sub_headings.heading: subcontracting
sub_headings.content: Sub-contractors from land-border countries must be registered with Competent Authority

sub_headings.heading: required_documents
sub_headings.content: Bid Security eBG (Form 3B), Bid Securing Declaration (Form 3A), Letter of Bid (Form 1), Bidder Information Sheet (Form 2), Power of Attorney (Form 4), Experience certificates, audited accounts (5 yrs), banker's certificate (Form 9), Price Adjustment Data (Form 16).

sub_headings.heading: declarations
sub_headings.content: Make-in-India / Local Content Affidavit – Class-I local supplier (≥50% local content) (Form 6), Compliance Undertaking + Deviations (Forms 11, 12), Work Completion Schedule (Form 13), Integrity Pact (Form 21).

sub_headings.heading: other_requirements
sub_headings.content: JV documents if applicable: Joint Deed of Undertaking (Form 7/8), JV Agreement. NO prices to be disclosed in Envelope 1 – violation = outright rejection.
